commands.command: git fetch --prune origin && test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "771b23456cf7b3fafe62cba3263e1f8f7118580b"

ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIALS=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d'); "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 1; PID=$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" forward --remove tcp:9222 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" forward tcp:9222 localabstract:webview_devtools_remote_$PID >/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(d)==1; print(d[0]["title"], d[0]["url"], d[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'

commands.command: WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS); let id=1; ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:id++,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`JSON.stringify({title:document.title,url:location.href,text:document.body.innerText,interactive:[...document.querySelectorAll("button,a,input,select,textarea,[role=button]")].map((e,i)=>({i,tag:e.tagName,text:(e.innerText||e.value||"").trim(),aria:e.getAttribute("aria-label"),disabled:!!e.disabled})).filter(x=>x.text||x.aria)})`,returnByValue:true}})); ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data); if(m.id===1){console.log(m.result.result.value); ws.close();}}; ws.onerror=e=>{console.error(e); process.exit(1)};'
